title: 2014 AMC 12A Problem 11
statement: David drives from his home to the airport to catch a flight. He drives \(35\) miles in the first hour, but realizes that he will be \(1\) hour late if he continues at this speed. He increases his speed by \(15\) miles per hour for the rest of the way to the airport and arrives \(30\) minutes early. How many miles is the airport from his home?

solutions.text:
Let \(d\) be the remaining distance after one hour and \(t\) the remaining time until the flight. At \(35\) mph he would be an hour late, so \(d=35(t+1).\) At \(50\) mph he is half an hour early, so \(d=50\left(t-\tfrac12\right).\)

Setting these equal gives \(35t+35=50t-25,\) so \(t=4\) and \(d=175.\)

The total distance is \(175+35=210\) miles.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Let \(t\) be the time still needed after the first hour, and write the remaining distance two ways
